calendar.clause: A Service delivered wholly within a single calendar day is delivered on the Service Day bearing that calendar date (H2 clause 2.2).

seven_am_unobserved.clause: A Service Day is the 24 hours from 07:00, so a service may fall in the Service Day beginning on the previous calendar date (H2 clause 2.2).
